summary: The best-looking app the factory has made — grained newsprint under a lamp, New York throughout, answers that take ink under a red stamp that judges nobody, a front page that prints itself at 112pt, and a night editor who never breaks character — and it is over on day 31, because Pack.swift:80 deals round 1's ten questions back in the same order forever, nothing reads the difficulty it prints on every sheet, and there is no Ladder, Mastery, Run or Earned in it.
fixes: Replace DailyPack.roundIndex's modulo (Pack.swift:80) with Mastery over all question ids so day 31 is ten questions chosen from what got past you, and grow the pack past 300
Add a Ladder keyed on editions filed that climbs the hard/medium mix to session ~150, and make QuizItem.difficulty the field the selector filters on instead of a caption
Adopt Run in TodayView so a clean sheet is at stake during the round, printed as a mono chain beside the tally that pencils out on a miss, costing the run and nothing else
Open one door with play instead of money: an Earned milestone at seven editions for a free adaptive 'late edition' built from what you missed, so CategoryStat finally chooses something
End the edition on earned.next(after:) in the editor's voice — 'Nineteen filed. The morgue opens at twenty-one.' — above the countdown, and print 'Day one on the desk.' on a ribbon sized to its type

Cap the verdict stamp to maxWidth 190 anchored bottom-trailing (QuestionSheet.swift:181-189) so long pool lines stop covering the answer in dark and at AX5, clamp the Today section line, and clear the version footer from behind the tab bar
Fix the moments: moment-answer.png is 18 blank frames and moment-win.png is 17 identical ones — move the demo presses to 6/10/14s and the win to 8/12s, delay 4.0s, 24 frames
